Title: Public preview: Rules for Azure Kubernetes Service and Log Analytic workspace resources

Body.Content:
The Azure portal now allows you to easily enable a set of recommended alert rules for your Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Log Analytics workspace resources. Enable a set of best practice alert rules on an unmonitored AKS and Log Analytics workspace resource with just a few clicks.

Learn more.
